speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, flank pain, and a fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To narrow down the cause of these symptoms, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as color, frequency, or odor?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any blood in your urine, or does it look cloudy or foul-smelling? Also, has anyone checked your blood pressure recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying the antibiotic reaction history. Given your current symptoms and the previous rash, could you tell me if your urine looks cloudy or has a strong odor? Also, have you experienced any pain or burning during urination?

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Differential and Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP). REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound. Do you have any recent imaging of your kidneys or abdomen from your sinusitis workup?
